workspace.title: Two TV models, one profit hill
workspace.scenario: A factory makes 19-inch and 21-inch televisions. Producing more units earns additional contribution, but price pressure and shared factory congestion eventually pull profit down. Explore the landscape and recommend a better production mix.

steps.title: Hill
steps.instruction: Read the contour map, compare today's point with the gold peak, and switch to the 3D surface to see why this model has a highest point.

steps.title: Slope
steps.instruction: Hold one TV model fixed. Move the other and connect the tangent line with the live value of one more unit.

steps.title: Walk
steps.instruction: Use both production sliders or drag the dark point. Follow the green gradient arrow until the factory is close to the top.

steps.title: Result
steps.instruction: Compare today's production mix with the best mix and turn the mathematical result into a management recommendation.

steps.title: Your Q
steps.instruction: Explain the recommendation, then change the business inputs to generate a new question from the same reusable workshop.

slope.prompt: With {held_product} held fixed, what happens to profit when the factory produces one more {moving_product}?

reflection.prompt: What production change should management make first, and what evidence from the graph supports your recommendation?
